accessDenied.title: Full-page heading when the signed-in user lacks agent:use. Product name Ask Khirby stays English in both locales. ≤4 words.
accessDenied.message: Body under that heading. One sentence: their role has no chat access, and they should ask an admin for agent:use. The token agent:use stays literal.
empty.title: Centered hero title on the chat page before the first message. Product name Ask Khirby. ≤2 words.
empty.subtitle: Sub-line under the hero title. One sentence inviting questions about CRM data, pipeline, or plugins. Glossary: pipeline stays 'pipeline'.
empty.integrationsCta: Link-style button when AI Compose is not configured. Routes to Integrations. One short phrase, imperative.
composer.placeholder: Placeholder in the message input at the bottom of the chat. Mentions contacts, leads, plugins. Ends with an ellipsis.
composer.send: Primary submit button beside the composer. Imperative, 1 word.
history.title: Heading above the thread list in the left rail. Noun, plural, 1 word.
history.new: Button that starts a fresh thread. ≤2 words.
history.deleteAction: title attribute on the delete control for a thread row. Imperative, ≤2 words.
history.deleteAria: aria-label of the delete button on a thread row. {title} is that thread's title.
history.deleteTitle: Title of the delete confirmation dialog. A question, ≤3 words.
history.deleteMessage: Body of that confirmation. {title} is the thread title wrapped in the locale's own quote marks. Says messages go away and the action cannot be undone.
history.deleteConfirm: Confirm button of that dialog. Names the action and object. Imperative, ≤3 words.
suggestions.contacts: Starter chip: a sample question about recent contacts. One short question.
suggestions.pipeline: Starter chip: a sample question about the sales pipeline.
suggestions.plugins: Starter chip: a sample question about installed plugins.
status.thinking: Inline status while the model is reasoning. Ends with an ellipsis.
status.writing: Inline status while tokens are streaming. Ends with an ellipsis.
status.runningTool: Inline status while a tool runs. {tool} is the tool name from the API. Ends with an ellipsis.
errors.ai_compose_unavailable: Error when the AI Compose plugin is missing or not configured. One sentence.
errors.network_error: Error when the SSE connection drops. One sentence with a retry hint.
errors.stream_in_progress: Error when the user sends while this thread is already streaming. One sentence.
message.copy: Button under a chat bubble that copies the message text to the clipboard. Imperative, 1 word. Width-constrained.
message.copied: Brief toast after a successful copy from a chat bubble. Past tense / confirmation, ≤2 words.
message.copyFailed: Toast when clipboard write fails. What happened + what to do. One short sentence.
